title.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon：聚焦长程编程与网络安全
title.en: Gemini 4 Carbon Targets Coding and Cybersecurity

excerpt.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon主打长程编程与网络安全任务。Google公布了多项基准成绩，并将先向部分网络防御人员开放，之后再逐步扩大使用范围。
excerpt.en: Gemini 4 Carbon targets long-horizon coding and cybersecurity work. Google reports strong benchmark results and plans a staged rollout, beginning with selected cyber defenders.

disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Google宣布推出Gemini 4 Carbon，将其定位为面向复杂编程和网络安全工作的前沿模型。公司称，该模型在长程代理任务中表现更强，目标是持续处理多步骤工程工作，而不只回答单次问题。
text.en: Google has announced Gemini 4 Carbon, positioning it as a frontier model for complex coding and cybersecurity work. The company says it is stronger on long-horizon agentic tasks, aiming to sustain multi-step engineering work rather than only answer one-off prompts.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon的基准成绩与工程定位
text.en: Gemini 4 Carbon’s benchmarks and engineering focus

text.zh: Google报告称，Carbon在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0中得分59，并在漏洞发现、利用验证和修复相关基准上分别取得88.2%、54.8%和71.0%。这些数字来自特定测试，不能直接代表所有真实环境中的效果。公司还称，内部测试显示其生成安全代码的成功率较Argon提升超过一倍；这些内部结果尚非独立验证。
text.en: Google reports a score of 59 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0, alongside results of 88.2%, 54.8%, and 71.0% on benchmarks for finding vulnerabilities, validating exploits, and fixing flaws. These figures reflect specific tests and do not establish performance across all real-world environments. The company also says internal testing found more than a twofold increase over Argon in success at generating secure code; those internal results are not independent validation.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon将分阶段开放，安全性仍待观察
text.en: Gemini 4 Carbon will roll out gradually, with safety still to assess

text.zh: 此次发布的另一重点是模型行为。Google称，Carbon在内部测试中减少了无依据的说法，并降低了提示注入攻击的成功率；公司也表示，它会在任务含糊时查找来源、指出差异，而非贸然猜测。这些是厂商披露的评估结果，实际可靠性仍需用户和独立测试进一步检验。
text.en: The announcement also emphasizes model behavior. Google says internal tests found fewer unsupported claims and a lower success rate for prompt-injection attacks. It says Carbon is designed to retrieve sources and flag discrepancies when a task is ambiguous instead of guessing. These are company-reported evaluations; users and independent testing will still need to establish how reliable the behavior is in practice.

text.zh: Google计划先向部分网络防御人员提供访问，再逐步扩展至可信合作伙伴，并在完善防护措施后向开发者、企业和消费者开放。发布初期价格与Argon相同：每百万输入token 2美元、输出token 10美元；优惠期后价格将分别升至4美元和20美元。分阶段部署反映出双重用途能力带来的现实考量：模型能帮助发现和修补漏洞，也可能需要严格控制其使用。开放时间、外部评估结果及广泛部署后的表现仍是关键待解问题。
text.en: Google plans to start with selected cyber defenders, expand access to trusted partners, and later offer Carbon to developers, businesses, and consumers as safeguards are refined. Introductory pricing matches Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens; after the introductory period, those prices rise to $4 and $20. The staged rollout reflects the implications of dual-use capabilities: a model that can help find and fix vulnerabilities may also require careful access controls. The timing of broader availability, independent evaluation, and performance at scale remain open questions.
